name: Mam nhum
summary: Mắm nhum is sea urchin salted and fermented in a clay jar into a thick, rich sauce that tastes strongly of the sea. Eat it with rice paper, herbs, rice, or noodles.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the finished sauce brown-red, thick, mildly salty, and strongly of the sea. ZaloPay calls it dark brown, thick, salty, rich, and sweet at the end.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: take the fresh red meat, salt it, and seal it in a clay jar for about one month. Eat it with rice noodles, shrimp-and-pork rolls, porridge, or rice paper, or cook it down as a vegetable dip.
ZaloPay: salt the fresh gut with sea salt and ferment it in a clay jar for many months, at Sa Huỳnh. Dip herbs, rice paper, or rice.
priceBand: 200,000 for a 200 g jar, with no currency word on the line (Vietnam Airlines).
seoDescription: Mắm nhum, sea urchin fermented in a clay jar at Sa Huỳnh into a thick sauce that tastes of the sea.
